papers.authors: K. S. Sreeramji, Sabyasachi Basu, Ravishankar Krishnaswamy, Kirankumar Shiragur, Yujia Wang
papers.tldr: 随着模型规模增大，嵌入向量量化成为关键，但现有方案多采用均匀位分配，未利用嵌入的几何结构。本文提出可变位分配框架，将嵌入划分为连续桶并贪心分配存储，实例化到PQ和SQ。在Matryoshka嵌入上，非均匀分配在相同存储下显著优于均匀基线，低比特率下Recall最高提升18%。该工作为结构感知的压缩与检索提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is a fundamental technique to handle the growing sizes of embeddings generated by modern models. Existing quantization schemes are largely embedding agnostic and allocate bits uniformly across dimensions. However, recent models produce embeddings with significant geometric structure. In this work, we investigate whether a variable bit allocation scheme can improve quantization quality under a fixed memory budget. We propose a simple variable bit allocation framework that partitions an embedding into contiguous buckets and allocates storage non-uniformly across them. Using a greedy allocation strategy, we instantiate this framework for both Product Quantization (PQ) and Scalar Quantization (SQ). We perform a series of experiments on embeddings known to have the Matryoshka property (MRL), and consistently observe that non-uniform allocations outperform uniform baselines at identical storage budgets. The largest improvements occur in the low-bit regime, where uniform allocation is particularly inefficient for MRL embeddings. At the same compression rates, variable allocation improves recall by up to 8\% for PQ and up to 18\% for SQ. Our results suggest a new direction for structure-aware compression and indexing techniques for large-scale retrieval systems.

papers.authors: Luka Ribar, Jeevan Bhoot, Douglas Orr
papers.evidence: 面向VLM的2.7位超低比特量化，直接对应极低比特VQ/SQ主题。
papers.tldr: 在资源受限的移动设备上部署视觉语言模型（VLM）面临内存和计算挑战。本文提出一种面向VLM的高效量化框架，利用模型自身生成训练数据，无需访问原始训练设置，并设计新颖的2.7-bit每参数格式，支持在Arm CPU上高效推理。作者将Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct模型压缩至3.7GB，激活值保持8-bit，在标准视觉问答任务上仍保持强性能，为边缘端部署提供了可行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) on mobile devices is challenging due to their significant memory and compute requirements. We present a framework for quantizing VLMs for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. Our approach combines a quantization pipeline that uses the model itself to generate training data and does not require access to the training setup, with a novel 2.7-bit-per-parameter format supporting efficient execution on Arm CPUs. We validate our approach by compressing the Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct model to 3.7 GB with 8-bit activations, preserving strong performance on a set of standard visual question answering tasks.

papers.title_en: Nexus: Structured Synergy for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation using Rectified Flow Model
papers.evidence: 面向高效文生图的低比特量化方法
papers.tldr: 文本到图像生成面临高计算和高内存的挑战。Nexus提出结合MoE前馈层、门控DeltaNet注意力与逐专家低比特训练的联合优化方案，实现稀疏架构、线性复杂度与低比特量化。在COCO和LAION上达到与SDXL、SD3相当的质量，同时显著提升推理效率。该工作为高分辨率合成与边缘部署提供了高效解决方案。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching models have made significant progress in text-to-image generation, yet high computation, quadratic complexity, and large memory footprint hinder high-resolution synthesis and edge deployment. We propose Nexus, which integrates sparse architecture, linear complexity, and low-bit quantization. It combines MoE feed-forward layers, gated DeltaNet attention, and per-expert low-bit training to reduce computation and memory. Their joint optimization allows Nexus to achieve generation quality comparable to mainstream models such as SDXL and SD3 while delivering markedly higher inference efficiency. Experiments on COCO and LAION validate its effectiveness.
